subject: What equipment does Aoi Todo use?

beats.title: Quotes
beats.text: (To himself) “Even this cursed spirit uses Black Flash. The one who is now being left behind is me. You've gotten strong, brother. Are you gonna just sit still, Aoi Todo?! Are you gonna let your brother feel alone again, Aoi Todo?!”(Chapter 128, Episode 44)

beats.title: Equipment
beats.text:
Cursed Tools
Playful Cloud 遊雲 Yū-un: While it was within his range of his technique, Todo was able to switch out Yuji to summon the special grade cursed tool to his side. By infusing it with his cursed energy, Todo could generate enough destructive force to smash Hanami's extremely hard shell.(Chapter 51, Episode 20) Non-Cursed Tools
Vibraslap ビブラスラップ Biburasurappu: A percussion instrument consisting of a ball connected to a wooden box with metal pieces inside. The player taps the ball to rattle the metal, thereby generating a unique sound. Todo replaced his lost left hand with one, using it in tandem with Boogie Woogie: Revised.(Chapter 260)

Aoi Todo 東堂葵 Tōdō Aoi is a major supporting character in the Jujutsu Kaisen series. He is a third-year student at Kyoto Jujutsu High School and a grade 1 jujutsu sorcerer. He was mentored by Yuki Tsukumo in his youth and considers Yuji Itadori to be his best friend.

beats.title: History
beats.text: Aoi Todo was born on September 23, 2000. When he was in grade school, he had met a sorcerer who asked what his type of woman was after he had just defeated a high school student. Aoi felt that this event would cure his boredom and went on to be trained by her in Jujutsu.(Chapter 50, Episode 20)(Fanbook) During this training he learned New shadow style from her.(Chapter 269) Years later on December 24, 2017, when Geto launched an attack at Shinjuku and Kyoto, Aoi had taken out 6 cursed spirits, 5 first-grade cursed spirits without using his cursed technique, and 1 special grade cursed spirit with his technique, all by himself.(Chapter 17, Episode 8)

beats.title: Abilities and Powers / Cursed Energy
beats.text: Cursed Energy Reinforcement: Todo has a good understanding of how to utilize cursed energy to reinforce his body. He is able to strengthen his punches enough to obliterate low-grade curses in a single punch(Chapter 34, Episode 15) and can infuse his energy into cursed tools.(Chapter 51, Episode 20) For defense, Todo can also apply a coating of cursed energy to his body to protect himself from attacks.(Chapter 51, Episode 20)

User(s): Aoi Todo
Type: Innate Technique
Move Range: Mid-Range
Capabilities: Offense
Manga Debut: Chapter 35
Anime Debut: Episode 15

Boogie Woogie 不義遊戯 Bugi Ugi is Aoi Todo's innate technique. It allows him to swap the orientation of anything with enough requisite cursed energy by clapping his hands.

beats.title: Summary
beats.text: Armed with a modified Boogie Woogie, Todo joins in the fight with Yuji to bring down Sukuna.

beats.title: Abilities and Powers / Overview
beats.text: Todo and Yuji turned out to be a good match and Todo showcased his intelligence and knowledge surrounding jujutsu sorcery and battles. Aoi's understanding of cursed energy allowed him to teach Yuji how to properly use it alongside his superhuman speed and strength. While fighting alongside Yuji, Todo was very nearly able to defeat Hanami, one of the most powerful special grade cursed spirits to have appeared.
